evidence.observation: Reboiler reads ~443 °C, physically implausible versus 63-75 °C column, and jumps 444→453.5→429 at k=15-17, suggesting sensor fault/drift
Reflux and distillate flows essentially zero (0-1.3 L/h) throughout while FYI702 reports ratio ~6, inconsistent
Column temperatures oscillate around 64-75 °C with no stable separation profile

args.missing_evidence: An independent reboiler temperature reference or heater duty signal to confirm T701 sensor fault, plus a distillate composition (GC) sample; pressure channels are not installed so hydraulics cannot be checked.
